Click the help icon above to learn more. */ div.jetpack-likes-widget-wrapper { width: 120px; } #content div.sharedaddy, #main div.sharedaddy, div.sharedaddy { float: left; clear: none; padding-right: 25px; padding-bottom: 25px; width: auto; }</style><!-- ema ----------------------------------------------------------------------- the toggle code for the mobile menue --><style type="text/css">#toggle-show-1:checked ~ .menu-header { height: auto; overflow: hidden; /*display:none; */ } #toggle-show-1:checked ~ #menu-menu{display:grid;} #toggle-show-1:checked ~ #wideScreenSearch {display:inline-block;}</style> <script>function showSolution(exampleNumber) 
{
var exampleID ="example"+exampleNumber;
var buttonID ="button"+exampleNumber;
var theButton= document.getElementById(buttonID)
var answerSpan = document.getElementById(exampleID)

if (theButton.getAttribute('value')==0)	
	{
	answerSpan.style.visibility="unset";
	theButton.value=1;
	theButton.style.backgroundColor="green";
	}
else
	{
	answerSpan.style.visibility="hidden";
	theButton.value=0;
	theButton.style.backgroundColor="white";
	}
}

function showHint(exampleNumber) 
{
var hintID ="hint"+exampleNumber;
var buttonID ="hintButton"+exampleNumber;
var theButton= document.getElementById(buttonID)
var hintSpan = document.getElementById(hintID)

if (theButton.getAttribute('value')==0)	
	{
	hintSpan.style.display="block";
	theButton.value=1;
	theButton.style.backgroundColor="goldenrod";
	theButton.style.color="black";
	}
else
	{
	hintSpan.style.display="none";
	theButton.value=0;
	theButton.style.backgroundColor="white";
	theButton.style.color="black";
	}
}


/* depricated probably but might still be used somewhere */
	
function showSolutionFullPhrase(theButton) 
{
answerSpan=theButton.parentElement.previousElementSibling.lastElementChild;
if (theButton.getAttribute('value')==0)
{
answerSpan.style.visibility="unset";
theButton.value=1;
theButton.style.backgroundColor="green";
}
else
{
answerSpan.style.visibility="hidden";
theButton.value=0;
theButton.style.backgroundColor="white";
}
}

The core idea of this root was “<em>mixing together”</em> with one of the main contexts being the mixing of ingredients of food. Mammoth stew with wild forest mushrooms for instance… hmmmmm. That was a good dish, I can tell you that.<br/> A lot has changed since then. Mammoths emigrated to space, we put a man on a moon and we talk to our computer. But one of the things that hasn’t changed is, we still eat. And <em><strong>rühren</strong></em> is still what we do, if we want to mix it.</p><p> <a class="more-link" href="https://yourdailygerman.com/ruehren-meaning/#more-20619">Continue reading <span
